provenance.instrument: General Laws of the Municipality of Norristown, Chapter 320 Zoning (Ord. No. 16-08 of 4-19-2016, as amended), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 (code NO0820) dated 2026-01-03. Norristown is a home rule municipality. The Census name is Norristown borough. New Laws lists three uncodified Chapter 320 amendments: Ord. 26-01 (amusement devices and arcades), 26-03 (significant tobacco retailers in CR) and 26-04 (data centers in HI). All three were opened. None touches residential districts or accessory dwellings. The Mixed-Use Overlay of Ord. 25-03 is codified as Article XXXIII and has no ADU text.
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360 code date 2026-01-03. New Laws: Ord. 26-01, 26-03 (2026-04-21) and 26-04 (2026-08-18), all Chapter 320, none residential.
checks: The zoning code has no accessory dwelling unit, accessory apartment or in-law provision
R-1 allows a single-family detached dwelling 'and for no other' principal use (320-26A). R-2 allows listed housing types 'and no other' (320-41A)

R-2 housing types are allowed only where three buildings of the same type already stand on the block. A duplex is allowed only if 'designed and originally constructed as such' (320-41A(3)). Converting a house to a duplex is not a listed use
Accessory buildings: rear yard only, at most 20% of the rear yard, 15 ft high, 5 ft from side and rear lines and from the house (320-230A, 320-231)
A freestanding accessory building over 600 sq ft or over 12 ft high needs a special exception and must meet the principal building setbacks (320-232A(2))
No structure on an alley lot (alley access only, no street frontage) may be built or converted for human habitation (320-238)
A family may be up to five unrelated people (320-11 'Family')
Renting a dwelling needs an annual rental license permit (Chapter 245, 245-2)
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Municipality of Norristown, code enforcement and zoning, https://www.norristown.org/. Searched Chapter 320 (full print view) for: accessory dwelling, accessory apartment, in-law, granny, ECHO, elder cottage, carriage house, guest house, caretaker, secondary dwelling, second dwelling, accessory family, accessory residential, accessory unit, conversion, kitchen. No ADU provision. A general 'use not expressly permitted elsewhere' special exception exists only in the HI district (320-161B(1)).

term.note: No ADU term. Searched for accessory dwelling, accessory apartment, in-law, granny, ECHO, elder cottage, carriage house, guest house, caretaker, secondary dwelling, second dwelling, accessory family, accessory residential, accessory unit, conversion, kitchen.

status.note: The code has no ADU text. R-1: 'Single-family detached dwelling' and 'for no other' principal use.

path.note: Reading: R-1 and R-2 list permitted uses 'and no other'. A second unit is not listed. A use variance is the path.

fallback_path.note: Same as path. The only catch-all special exception for unlisted uses is in the HI district (320-161B(1)).

zoning_districts.note: No district lists an ADU. Reading of a silent code.

historic_bypass.note: No ADU text, so no historic path.

value.condition: No structure on an alley lot (access only on an alley, no street frontage) may be built or converted for human habitation.

gates.note: 'No structure shall be erected ... for human habitation on an alley lot.'

max_height_ft.note: Accessory rule, not an ADU rule. Accessory buildings 'shall not exceed 15 feet in height'. Over 12 ft needs a special exception (320-232A(2)).

setback_side_ft.note: Accessory rule: not 'closer than five feet to a rear or side lot line'. Buildings over 600 sq ft or 12 ft take the principal setbacks (320-232A(2)(a)).

setback_rear_ft.note: Accessory rule: 5 ft. Rear yard only (320-230A(1)).

setback_front_ft.note: Detached accessory structures are permitted 'in the rear yard only'.

separation_ft.note: 'no closer than five feet from the permitted principal structure'

accessory_structure_max_sqft.note: Not an ADU rule. A freestanding accessory building over 600 sq ft or 12 ft 'shall be a special exception'. Also at most 20% of the rear yard (320-230A(1)).

family_only.note: No ADU rule. A family may include up to five unrelated people.

max_adus.note: Reading: 0 means the code allows no ADU.

spaces_required.note: No ADU row. Single-family detached: 'Two parking spaces exclusive of garage space.' Duplex: one per unit.

min_lot_sqft.note: Median of single-family lots on the block, 'but in no case shall be less than 5,000 square feet'.

setback_side_ft.note: Set by the adjacent houses. 'In no case ... less than 10 feet.' 20 ft if both sides are vacant. Principal yard.

setback_rear_ft.note: Set by the adjacent houses. 'In no case ... less than 20 feet.' Principal yard.

min_lot_sqft.note: Median of the same housing type on the block, not less than 3,000 sq ft per single-family detached dwelling.

setback_side_ft.note: Set by the adjacent houses. Not less than 5 ft. 15 ft if both sides are vacant. Principal yard.

setback_rear_ft.note: Set by the adjacent houses. Not less than 15 ft. Principal yard.

max_building_coverage.note: Single-family detached on a 5,001 to 10,000 sq ft lot. 30% for 3,000 to 5,000 sq ft and 20% above 10,000 sq ft.

principal_max_height_ft.note: Median height on the block, 'in no case shall exceed 40 feet'.
